current_tagline: Classic clue-slinging. Keep it vague keep it clean.
current_gameplay_flow: Players privately view prompts -> clue discussion -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: Give one clue and avoid saying your exact prompt. Vote for who sounds suspicious.
current_host_stinger_style: Direct and chaotic host intros emphasizing blending in
player_experience_notes: Baseline mode and easiest for new players

current_tagline: Same scenario for everyone. Liars must argue against their own instincts.
current_gameplay_flow: Players get same scenario prompt -> discussion/debate -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: Everyone got the same scenario. Liars must argue opposite to their natural take and sound convincing.
current_host_stinger_style: Debate-focused stingers about conviction and attitude
player_experience_notes: Feels like social debate round with performance pressure

current_tagline: A picture paints a thousand lies.
current_gameplay_flow: Players privately view image-based prompts -> discussion -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: Use visual clue details without revealing exact image/prompt. Vote for who seems off.
current_host_stinger_style: Visual-detail stingers that reward subtle clues
player_experience_notes: Great for quick reaction and descriptive bluffing

current_tagline: Everyone decodes a meme vibe. Liars defend the wrong format.
current_gameplay_flow: Players get meme-style prompt variants -> discussion -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: Explain meme format and vibe naturally. Liars have a different meme framing and must fake it.

current_tagline: No words. Make the sound and hide in the chaos.
current_gameplay_flow: Players perform sound-only clue -> discussion/vibe read -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: No words allowed when clueing. Perform your prompt as sound only and keep it believable.
current_host_stinger_style: Performance stingers about committing to audio-only clue
player_experience_notes: High-energy and funny with strong table reactions

current_tagline: Liars get a rogue scenario and must argue like it belongs.
current_gameplay_flow: Truth players share one scenario while liar has unrelated one -> discussion -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: Defend your scenario naturally. Liars must make unrelated prompt sound relevant to the room.
player_experience_notes: Great for improvisers and persuasive players

current_tagline: Different clue cards one hidden topic. Find the broken link.
current_gameplay_flow: Players receive different linked clues with liar decoy -> discussion -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: Describe your clue card naturally. Identify who sounds like their clue does not fit the chain.
player_experience_notes: More deduction-heavy than other social rounds

current_tagline: Ask by mic hear spoken AI answers. Liars know the hidden prompt.
current_gameplay_flow: Players ask AI host questions (mic optional) -> answers guide deductions -> voting -> liar reveal
current_rules_text_current: Interrogate the AI host with sharp questions. Liars already know hidden prompt and may steer conversation.
player_experience_notes: Unique AI-assisted mode and strong differentiator
